description: Tier 3 (HyperSCN) benchmark. Inputs are Tier 2 SCN strings. Each case verifies: (1) critical invariants survive, (2) minimum compression ratio met, (3) output is deterministic. Modality markers (NEG:, POSS:, OBL:) and all entities, numbers, dates must pass through unchanged.

cases.scn:
RAISE a0:$a a1:rates
RAISE a0:$b a1:yields
RAISE a0:$c a1:premiums
RAISE a0:$d a1:spreads
cases.note: Single repeated predicate (RAISE x4) should be aliased

cases.scn:
NEG:APPROVE a0:committee a1:budget
APPROVE a0:board a1:hiring
NEG:APPROVE a0:team a1:proposal
APPROVE a0:ceo a1:acquisition
NEG:APPROVE a0:investors a1:deal
cases.note: NEG: modality marker preserved as prefix; APPROVE can alias but remains semantically reachable via legend

cases.scn:
POSS:RAISE a0:Fed a1:rates tm:June
OBL:COMPLY a0:firms a1:regulations
NEG:APPROVE a0:board a1:merger
POSS:ANNOUNCE a0:CEO a1:departure
OBL:DISCLOSE a0:companies a1:material-info
cases.note: All modality markers (POSS, OBL, NEG) preserved verbatim
@E and $ entity definitions + references all preserved

cases.scn:
RAISE a0:$a a1:rates a2:+50bp
RAISE a0:$b a1:yields a2:+25bp
RAISE a0:$c a1:premiums a2:+10bp
DECLINE a0:EUR-USD a1:-2.1%
DECLINE a0:GBP-USD a1:-1.8%
DECLINE a0:JPY-USD a1:-0.9%
cases.note: Numbers, percentages, and currency pairs preserved exactly

cases.scn:
ANNOUNCE a0:$a a1:Q1-results tm:March-15
ANNOUNCE a0:$b a1:Q2-results tm:June-30
ANNOUNCE a0:$c a1:Q3-results tm:September-30
ANNOUNCE a0:$d a1:Q4-results tm:December-31
cases.note: tm: role prefix kept + all date values preserved

cases.scn:
RAISE a0:$a a1:rates a2:+50bp
→CAUSE: EXCEED a0:inflation a1:target tm:6mo
→RESULT: DECLINE a0:EUR-USD a1:-2.1%
ANNOUNCE a0:$b a1:response
→CONTRAST: HOLD a0:Fed a1:rates
RAISE a0:$c a1:yield-cap a2:+10bp
→SEQUENCE: DECLINE a0:JPY a1:-0.5%

@E1=European-Central-Bank(type:org)
ANNOUNCE a0:$a a1:monetary-policy tm:Wednesday
RAISE a0:$a a1:rates a2:+50bp tm:Thursday mn:unexpected cs:inflation
STATE a0:chairman a1:hawkish-tone
EXPECT a0:$a a1:more-hikes tm:H2-2026
RAISE a0:Fed a1:rates a2:+25bp tm:last-month
STATE a0:Powell a1:committed-to-target
RAISE a0:BOJ a1:yield-cap a2:+10bp
STATE a0:Kuroda a1:flexible-policy
NEG:APPROVE a0:ECB-council a1:coordinated-intervention
POSS:RAISE a0:BOE a1:rates tm:August
→CAUSE: EXCEED a0:inflation a1:target
→RESULT: DECLINE a0:EUR-USD a1:-2.1%
→RESULT: DECLINE a0:JPY a1:-1.3%
cases.note: Full stress test: entities + numbers + dates + modality + discourse + multiple repeated predicates
